DONE. I built the film, but I couldn't check it visually. `openfilm look` needs ffmpeg and ffprobe, which aren't installed, so I haven't seen any frames. I haven't confirmed that nothing is cut off or overlapping, and I haven't run the check that the same time always draws the same picture. `film/BUILD_NOTES.md` says the same.

- **Pages:** `film/` has five scene pages, `s1.html` to `s5.html`. They share `common.css` and `common.js`, and each follows the visual idea in the scene plan.
- **Timeline:** `film.html` cuts the five pages end to end on one track, from 0 to 41.43 s with no gaps. `voice.wav` sits on its own audio track at volume 1.
- **Text and layout:** Headlines are 84 px with one accent colour. I kept the lower 22% of the frame free of key text and drew no subtitles. `voice.wav` and `voice.vtt` are untouched.
